claims: The Dallas Stars are currently facing the Minnesota Wild in the first round of the 2026 NHL playoffs.
The Dallas Stars had a 6-1 home loss in Game 1 on April 18, 2026.
Game 2 is scheduled for April 20, 2026, at 6:30 PM.
Game 2 is a home game for the Dallas Stars.
Victory+ is the primary app for viewing games in Texas, Oklahoma, Louisiana, and Arkansas.
Select games are available on ESPN+, TNT, or ABC.
The venue is American Airlines Center, Dallas, TX.
The Dallas Stars entered the playoffs with a 50-20-12 record.
The Dallas Stars ranked 2nd in the Central Division.
